_about: The MAP Team Queue's HAND-TRACKED lane. Everything else on that tab is MEASURED from a live source at page load and therefore cannot go stale. These items have no live source — nothing in Supabase or the repo knows whether they are done — so they are listed here, deliberately separated, and rendered with their staleness showing.
_why_separate: Session 131 measured the six-item MAP-team backlog that the session-130 handoff carried in prose. Two of its items were already wrong within two days: it said 'every governance owner unset' when the team had filled all 17 owner-bearing rows on Aug 5 and 7, and it said '6 open Sierra feedback rows' when there were 23 real ones. A written list of work decays silently, because nothing re-checks it. So the rule for this tab is: if it can be measured, measure it; if it cannot, put it HERE, where the UI shows how long it has been since a human last confirmed it. A hand-tracked item that nobody has confirmed in weeks should LOOK unreliable, because it is.
_rule: Add an item here ONLY after checking that no live source could answer it. When one becomes measurable, delete it here and measure it instead. Bump last_confirmed whenever a human actually re-checks the item — not when the file is edited for other reasons.

items.title: Malone: the Custom Report view name that unblocks the nightly feed
items.detail: docs/map_custom_report_request_for_malone.md is written and forwardable. It is blocked on one thing — the name of the published API view carrying CPLStatusPlan. Everything on our side is a ~4-line change once we have it. Until then the credit-disposition data is a manual Access export and cannot refresh nightly.
items.blocks: The college action page promises current to-dos. Daily to-dos computed off month-old data get caught in the first week, so the nightly feed is a prerequisite for that page, not a nice-to-have.
items.note: Blocks the NIGHTLY REFRESH only, not the data — cpl_status_plan is 100% populated in map_college_cr_unit (verified 2026-08-09). docs/map_dataset_sql_for_malone.md is a server-side path that needs no published view.

items.title: Verify creditforbeingyou.org/main/student resolves
items.detail: Sierra sends CPL seekers to the Credit for Being You student portal in several rules. No session has been able to confirm the URL loads — the sandbox is egress-blocked from that domain, so this needs a human with a browser. A wrong link here sends a real student to a dead end.
items.blocks: Nothing structurally, but it is the one externally-visible claim Sierra makes that we have never checked.

items.title: SkyHero's five-surface anti-poaching audit was never reported
items.detail: Sierra is embedded on colleges' own pages, so an unprompted 'you would get more credit elsewhere' is poaching. A five-surface audit of where that rule is enforced was started and its findings were never written down anywhere, so nobody knows whether it passed.
items.blocks: Not blocking, but it is an unfinished check on a live public surface.
